summary: Phase 2 (Meetings, Elections, public Verify) end-to-end test. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases PASS — meetings CRUD/filters/meeting_no/cascade-delete of resolutions, elections CRUD, candidate UID validation, vote happy-path + duplicate + non-active + closed rejections, conclude marks Elected/Defeated, public /api/verify/{uid} returns correct shape for active/pending/invalid UIDs, dashboard now exposes upcoming_meetings & elections_open. Frontend: BLOCKING ISSUE — /app/frontend/src/App.js does NOT register any of the Phase 2 routes; all /meetings*, /elections*, and the public /verify/:uid routes fall through to the catch-all `<Navigate to="/" replace/>`. Page components (Meetings.jsx, MeetingDetail.jsx, MeetingNew.jsx, Elections.jsx, ElectionDetail.jsx, ElectionNew.jsx, Verify.jsx) and the API helpers in lib/api.js exist correctly with data-testids, but they are unreachable in the running app. Sidebar also still lists 'AGM & Meetings' and 'Elections' under FUTURE_NAV (no `to` prop, not clickable) instead of PRIMARY_NAV.

minor.issue: Uses MeetingCreate (full body) rather than a partial; UI must send the entire object to update one field. Acceptable but consider a Partial schema.

ui_bugs.issue: Phase 2 routes are not registered. Missing: /meetings, /meetings/new, /meetings/:id, /elections, /elections/new, /elections/:id, and public /verify/:uid. The catch-all `<Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/' replace/>}/>` consumes every Phase 2 URL.
'AGM & Meetings' and 'Elections' are in FUTURE_NAV without a `to` prop → rendered as inactive labels under the 'Forthcoming Phases' section, NOT as live links under PRIMARY_NAV as required.

integration_issues.issue: /verify/MPCA-IND-0001 and /verify/MPCA-FOO-9999 both redirect to '/' (Landing) because route is missing in App.js. QR codes on identity cards will land users on the wrong page.
All meetings UI is unreachable until routes are added to App.js. Page logic itself looks correct (uses fetchMeetings, fetchResolutions, etc.).
Same — unreachable until routes added. Page components reference correct API helpers (castVote, concludeElection, addCandidate).

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is the canonical wiring layer — verifying that newly-added page components are actually mounted should be part of every E1 self-check. Currently 7 new components exist but are dead code at runtime.

Meeting PATCH endpoint (server.py:392) accepts MeetingCreate (all required fields). UI doing partial updates must round-trip the entire meeting. Consider adding `Partial[MeetingBase]` schema for status-only transitions.
/api/elections/{id}/conclude allows concluding without ever opening voting (no status check). Consider rejecting unless status == 'Voting_Open' to enforce the lifecycle.
server.py is now 856 lines — at ~1.2× the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (members.py / disclosures.py / meetings.py / elections.py / verify.py) before Phase 3.

MemberCard.jsx QR is rendered with a remote https://api.qrserver.com URL — if the printer/scanner is offline this fails silently. For production printing consider embedding a local QR generator (e.g. qrcode.react) so cards print regardless of network.

rca of the issue: Root cause is purely missing wiring in /app/frontend/src/App.js. Page components were created and Linked correctly, the API client functions (fetchMeetings, createMeeting, fetchResolutions, addResolution, fetchElections, createElection, fetchCandidates, addCandidate, castVote, concludeElection, verifyMember) all exist, but App.js was never updated with the corresponding <Route> entries. The catch-all `<Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/' replace />}/>` therefore intercepts every Phase 2 URL and silently redirects to Landing. Reproduction: open /verify/MPCA-IND-0001 in an incognito window — you land on /. Mitigation is purely adding the 7 routes (1 public, 6 protected) as suggested in action_items[0]; no business logic change required.
